name: muiltchat-monorepo
description: Cross-session context query and conversation system for AI coding assistants (monorepo root)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run serve -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
